publication.title: Curating a document collection via crowdsourcing with Pundit 2.0

source_reading.scope: Abstract, annotation configuration, complete demo workflow (§2), related-work comparison and final functionality list.

adjudication.basis: The construction exclusion applies when no interactive exploration contribution exists. This demo implements real RDF-derived document facets and linked timeline/map exploration, updated from annotations. That contribution is documented rather than hypothetical.

codes.notes: Pundit annotation modifies an attested faceted library exploration workflow. Suggestions/templates guide annotation. Timeline established; map details not independently coded. No recruited evaluation.

The demo centres on semantic annotation and collaborative KG creation, but also implements a faceted document browser and linked timeline whose contents are updated from RDF annotations. Adjudicate the review boundary between exploration applications with curation and construction-only tools; the browsing component is real and must not be dismissed as merely a future goal.
